CURRENT card: ${workflow:text} / ${pipeline:text} / ${run_type:text}.
Open First Action; VERIFY means evidence is missing. SELECTED RUN is persisted history.

panels.description: Distinguishes CURRENT Prometheus snapshot (Fleet Health, First Action, Domain Status), SELECTED RUN persisted HTTP evidence, and TIME RANGE history. Domain Status is a current snapshot of up to 2 rows, not the time picker. Pipeline and Run Type affect current and historical evidence; Run ID never filters Prometheus. UNKNOWN means missing or stale evidence, never healthy. To inspect a selected run, set a concrete run_id (not -) after choosing pipeline/run_type. Default run_id=- keeps fleet/current status only — exact identity/processed-record panels stay empty until a run is selected. Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Status
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence. Reason explains the saved assessment; missing archive evidence remains INCOMPLETE. Evidence completeness remains available in the saved report.

panels.description: CURRENT · Fresh pipeline/run_type telemetry only. CURRENT selected-pipeline routes across selected run types; not a SELECTED RUN verdict. One row per pipeline and action/reason, taking the highest urgency across run types with all routes available through pagination. Open Action on the top row first. Priority is routing urgency: URGENT > HIGH > REVIEW > WATCH, not inferred alert severity. Provider degradation is GLOBAL; confirm the provider in Provider Health. Only positive routes participate. NO_ROUTE is an absence-only fallback when no positive route survives (or on()); it is not a healthy zero or VALID EMPTY. Verify telemetry and selection before a health conclusion. TELEMETRY MISSING is not zero. TIME RANGE sets current evaluation time. UNKNOWN routes are VERIFY, not claims of degradation. Confirmed incidents retain their domain priority.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN

panels.description: TIME RANGE · SELECTED RUN · Shows Runtime status over the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. Values are OK, WARN, CRIT, or UNKNOWN; missing samples remain UNKNOWN. This trend does not determine current Fleet Health; open Pipeline Diagnostics for current blockers. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: history (state-timeline) of L1 runtime over the range; the snapshot table is Review Runtime Status (9003). Outlined intervals use semantic state colors; hover for exact interval boundaries. Gaps mean no observed samples, not OK.

panels.title: Review Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · TIME RANGE · Shows HTTP-backed Bronze, Silver, and Gold record counts and outcomes. Zero is a recorded count. No matching rows are a valid empty result for the selected scope; backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Open Run Explorer for complete accounting. Counts and percentages are neutral accounting quantities, not quality verdicts. Exclusions alone have no severity threshold here; assess the DQ verdict and contract evidence. Percentages use the same precision (at least one decimal, up to three for small shares).
